name: openenlink
description: Connect to Enlink VPN gateways through a local SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy.
author: Ge Gao (Snowflyt) <gaoge011022@gmail.com>

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { NtExecutable, NtExecutableResource } from 'pe-library'; import { Data, Resource } from 'resedit'; import tsBlankSpace from 'ts-blank-space'; fs.rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true }); const assets = {}; const add = (file) => { assets[path.relative('.', file).replaceAll(path.sep, '/')] = file; }; const files = (directory) => fs.readdirSync(directory, { recursive: true }).map((file) => path.join(directory, file)).filter((file) => fs.statSync(file).isFile()); for (const file of files('src')) { const output = path.join('dist', path.relative('src', file).replace(/[.]ts$/, '.js')); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(output), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(output, tsBlankSpace(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).replaceAll(/(\x22[.][.]?[/][^\x22]*)[.]ts\x22/g, (_, head) => head + '.js\x22')); add(output); } for (const directory of execFileSync(process.execPath, [process.env.npm_execpath, 'ls', '--all', '--omit=dev', '--parseable'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim().split(/\r?\n/).slice(1)) for (const file of files(directory)) if (!path.relative(directory, file).split(path.sep).includes('node_modules')) add(file); const tcpip = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip'; for (const file of ['package.json', tcpip + '/package.json', tcpip + '/tcpip.wasm', ...files(tcpip + '/dist')]) add(file); let node = process.execPath; const [release, prerelease] = process.versions.node.split('-'); const compare = (a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'en', { numeric: true }); if ((compare(release, '27.0.0') || (prerelease ? compare(prerelease, 'alpha.0.1.1') : 1)) < 0) { const response = await fetch('https://nodejs.org/download/release/v27.0.0-alpha.0.1.1/' + (process.platform === 'win32' ? 'win-' + process.arch + '/node.exe' : 'node-v27.0.0-alpha.0.1.1-' + process.platform + '-' + process.arch + (process.platform === 'linux' && !process.report.getReport().header.glibcVersionRuntime ? '-musl' : '') + '.tar.gz')); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('No Node.js build at ' + response.url); const download = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()); fs.mkdirSync('dist/node'); if (process.platform === 'win32') { node = 'dist/node/node.exe'; fs.writeFileSync(node, download); } else { node = 'dist/node/bin/node'; execFileSync('tar', ['-xzf', '-', '-C', 'dist/node', '--strip-components', '1'], { input: download }); } } const output = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'dist/openenlink.exe' : 'dist/openenlink'; fs.writeFileSync('dist/sea-main.js', 'import ' + JSON.stringify('./dist/cli.js') + ';'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/sea-config.json', JSON.stringify({ assets, disableExperimentalSEAWarning: true, execArgv: ['--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning'], main: 'dist/sea-main.js', mainFormat: 'module', output, useVfs: true })); execFileSync(node, ['--build-sea', 'dist/sea-config.json'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (process.platform === 'win32') { const executable = NtExecutable.from(fs.readFileSync(output), { ignoreCert: true }); const resources = NtExecutableResource.from(executable); const [group] = Resource.IconGroupEntry.fromEntries(resources.entries); Resource.IconGroupEntry.replaceIconsForResource(resources.entries, group.id, group.lang, Data.IconFile.from(fs.readFileSync('assets/icon.ico')).icons.map((icon) => icon.data)); resources.outputResource(executable); fs.writeFileSync(output, Buffer.from(executable.generate())); } if (process.platform === 'darwin') execFileSync('codesign', ['--sign', '-', output], { stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.chmodSync(output, 0o755); for (const file of fs.readdirSync('dist')) if (file !== path.basename(output)) fs.rmSync(path.join('dist', file), { recursive: true });"
scripts.postinstall: git submodule update --init vendor/tcpip.js vendor/lwip && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; try { execFileSync('git', ['apply', '--reverse', '--check', '../tcpip.js.patch'], { cwd: 'vendor/tcpip.js', stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch { execFileSync('git', ['apply', '../tcpip.js.patch'], { cwd: 'vendor/tcpip.js', stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { stripTypeScriptTypes } from 'node:module'; import path from 'node:path'; const source = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip/src'; const dist = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip/dist'; fs.rmSync(dist, { force: true, recursive: true }); for (const file of fs.readdirSync(source, { encoding: 'utf8', recursive: true })) { if (!file.endsWith('.ts') || /\.test(-d)?\.ts$/.test(file)) continue; const output = path.join(dist, file.replace(/\.ts$/, '.js')); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(output), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(output, stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync(path.join(source, file), 'utf8'))); }" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; if (!fs.existsSync('.cache/wasi-sdk-24')) { const platform = { 'darwin-arm64': 'arm64-macos', 'darwin-x64': 'x86_64-macos', 'linux-arm64': 'arm64-linux', 'linux-x64': 'x86_64-linux', 'win32-arm64': 'x86_64-windows', 'win32-x64': 'x86_64-windows' }[process.platform + '-' + process.arch]; if (!platform) throw new Error('wasi-sdk 24 has no build for ' + process.platform + '-' + process.arch); const name = 'wasi-sdk-24.0-' + platform; fs.mkdirSync('.cache', { recursive: true }); execFileSync('curl', ['-fL', '-o', name + '.tar.gz', 'https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-24/' + name + '.tar.gz'], { cwd: '.cache', stdio: 'inherit' }); execFileSync('tar', ['-xzf', name + '.tar.gz'], { cwd: '.cache', stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.rmSync('.cache/' + name + '.tar.gz'); fs.renameSync('.cache/' + name, '.cache/wasi-sdk-24'); }" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; const tcpip = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip'; const lwip = 'vendor/lwip/src'; const files = (makefile, variable, directory) => new RegExp('^' + variable + '=(.*)', 'm').exec(fs.readFileSync(makefile, 'utf8').replaceAll(/\x5c\r?\n/g, ' '))[1].trim().split(/\s+/).map((file) => file.replace(/^[$][(]\w+[)]/, directory)); execFileSync('.cache/wasi-sdk-24/bin/clang', ['--target=wasm32-wasi', '-I' + lwip + '/include', '-I' + tcpip + '/wasm/include', '-Oz', '-Wall', '-std=c11', '-Wl,--gc-sections,--strip-all,--export=malloc,--export=free,--allow-undefined', '-mexec-model=reactor', '-o', tcpip + '/tcpip.wasm', ...files(tcpip + '/wasm/Filelists.mk', 'SRC_FILES', tcpip + '/wasm'), ...['COREFILES', 'CORE4FILES', 'NETIFFILES'].flatMap((variable) => files(lwip + '/Filelists.mk', variable, lwip))], { stdio: 'inherit' });" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('.git')) execFileSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks']);"
